claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for deployment only as a disclosed-risk certification: aggregate results support launch readiness, the small-business support slice remains an unresolved weakness, no approved mitigation removes exposure, and certification is therefore supportable only if the model card explicitly discloses that weakness and follow-up confirmation is performed.
specific_concerns: The evidence supports a conditional path to certification, but does not show that the required model-card disclosure has actually been made.

The record does not explicitly establish the unresolved small-business support weakness as materially affecting a protected or contractual customer segment; that predicate is assumed rather than directly evidenced.

The actor's recommendation is stronger than the evidentiary record because it moves from 'certification may proceed only if disclosed' to 'approve certification' without evidence of the completed disclosure artifact.
unsupported_claims: That the current packet already satisfies the policy threshold for certification, rather than only identifying the conditions under which certification could be compliant.
That the small-business support slice weakness is definitively material under the policy, as opposed to plausibly material but not expressly determined in the admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual model-card or certification packet text showing the explicit disclosure of the small-business support weakness.
Provide the materiality determination or segment classification showing that small-business support is a protected or contractual customer segment under the disclosure policy.
Provide the final approval record, if any, showing certification was granted on the disclosed-risk basis rather than assumed from the evaluation tables alone.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates can support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
An unapproved draft mitigation does not satisfy the approved-mitigation exception.
Small-sample uncertainty can justify follow-up confirmation but cannot convert an unresolved weakness into a clean certification.
A conditional certification claim is only fully supported if the record shows the required disclosure condition is actually met.
